content: Runaway agent cost: context accumulation means each loop step resends full history (quadratic growth); retry storms on failing endpoints; documented incidents e.g. $48k GPT-4o burn in 14h from one session; agents use ~50x tokens of chat, multi-agent ~10-15x single agent. Controls: hard per-task/per-day token budgets, max-iteration limits, no-progress detection, circuit breakers on cost velocity + repeated prompts, exponential backoff with jitter, gateway-level rate limits separate from daily budget, fallback chains to cheaper model/cache.
